verdict.rationale: Cubic documents custom agents as review rules that enforce an organization's own best practices, with community-library adoption and configuration as code via cubic.yaml, including org-wide config. It also auto-ingests repo context files (AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .ai/) and pulls style or architecture docs from Confluence and Notion, and an HN commenter independently confirms the plain-English-rules-in-codebase approach while debating its determinism. Missing for 10: any evidence of AST/structural pattern rules, detail on the custom-agent rule syntax and how strictly rules are enforced, and deterministic or hands-on validation that rules are reliably applied.
